name: Hu-Go! GX
author: Eke-Eke
description_long: Hu-Go! GX is a port of the Hu-Go! emulator for the Nintendo GameCube. It plays PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16 games with 16-bit stereo 32kHz audio, ROMs up to 2.5MB, battery RAM saves to memory card or SD, and ROM loading from SD card or DVD.

license.notes: Inherited from upstream Hu-Go! by David Michel (GPL-2.0); no LICENSE file shipped in the GameCube port repository.
